$description: Ansh Desai — personal brand design tokens. Single source of truth for the website, the Claude usage widget, slides, and matplotlib plots. Keep tokens.css in sync (generated from this file).

principles: Blues do the work; orange is the spark (orange ~5-10% usage, reserved for 'signal').
Concept: cool blue = the detector/noise field, warm orange = the dark-matter signal emerging.
Charter for display, IBM Plex Sans for body/UI, IBM Plex Mono for all numbers.
The asterisk/star (✱, U+2731) is the signature glyph.

deep.comment: ROLE: structure/authority — heading ink, borders, primary buttons

azure.comment: ROLE: interaction — links, focus, ✱ glyph, default data/bars

orange.comment: ROLE: the SIGNAL — rare emphasis, active/now, threshold crossed

star.comment: U+2731 — signature mark; bullets, dividers, accents

adaptiveAccentHot.comment: fraction at which bars/values switch azure -> orange (the 'signal')
